Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Giuliano Carnimeo died in 1974—confusing the film’s release year with the director’s death year—despite earlier WebSurfer results confirming Carnimeo died in 2016. This misreporting led to a wrong comparison and final conclusion that Poker in Bed’s director died earlier, contradicting the verified data (Rossellini died in 1977, Carnimeo in 2016).
